run_f_gold: run f_gold(n, k) to generate a string of length n using k distinct characters with no adjacent duplicates
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets to verify correctness
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which cycles through k lowercase letters to build a non-adjacent distinct character string
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand how it alternates k characters to avoid adjacent duplicates in the result
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use string join instead of repeated concatenation for better performance
